title: 🔆🔅Iran’s Oil Minister Goes Car-Free to Work in Fuel-Saving Campaign
text:
🔆🔅Iran’s Oil Minister Goes Car-Free to Work in Fuel-Saving Campaign"

""
"Paknejad takes metro without visible bodyguards or security detail as part of “One Day a Week Without a Car” initiative"

"TEHRAN, September 19th — Iran’s Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad went to work without a car as part of the “One Day a Week Without a Car” campaign, in a move presented as leading by example in efforts to manage gasoline consumption."

"The accompanying footage shows Paknejad riding the metro without any visible bodyguards or security detail."

"The campaign encourages officials and the public to leave their cars at home one day a week to help reduce fuel consumption and traffic.
